is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.l. (page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the Vgsc L1014S (kdr) mutation (Table 5, page 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis before and after intervention in both trial arms (page 6).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Muheza District, Tanga Region, Tanzania, using field-collected mosquitoes (page 1, 8).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical cluster randomized controlled trial (page 1, 8).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Muheza District, Tanga Region, Tanzania (page 1, 8).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study monitoring period was between April 2021 and March 2022 (page 8).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new primary study (NCT05150808) conducted in 2021-2022.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Table 5 of the main text.

assessment.summary: A cluster randomized controlled trial in Muheza, Tanzania, evaluating the non-inferiority of VECTRON T500 (broflanilide) compared to Fludora Fusion (clothianidin + deltamethrin). The study reports kdr (L1014S) genotype frequencies for An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis before and after intervention.
